info.title: Relayquill Control & Ingestion HTTP API
info.description: Lossless UTF-8 webhook delivery, schema/representation registry, passkey session/CSRF/step-up auth, two-person governance, and authenticated SSE watch streaming API.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-rq_session
sessionCookie.description: Authenticated human session cookie (__Host-rq_session in release_https, rq_session_dev in development).

preauthCookie.name: __Host-rq_pre
preauthCookie.description: Pre-authentication WebAuthn binding cookie (__Host-rq_pre or rq_pre_dev).

csrfHeader.name: X-Relayquill-CSRF
csrfHeader.description: CSRF token bound to current authenticated session (also accepts X-CSRF-Token).

stepUpHeader.name: X-Relayquill-Step-Up
stepUpHeader.description: Single-use passkey operation proof identifier for high-privilege governance actions.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key scoping command execution and safe replay.

producerBearer.description: Machine producer bearer credential scoped to project admission/status/watch.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON bytes preserving arbitrary-precision integers and decimals without IEEE-754 coercion.

utf8_json_text.description: Byte-exact UTF-8 JSON payload preserving lossless 64-bit+ numbers.
